title: Answer Engine Optimization Platform | SolCrys AEO
heading: Answer engine optimization software for marketing teams
description: Track AI search visibility, find why brands are mentioned or missed, and verify your fixes with SolCrys AEO.
intro: See how AI search describes and recommends your brand. Find the pages and sources behind those answers, turn the findings into changes your team can approve, and rerun the same questions after you publish.

sections.title: Measure AI visibility
sections.text: Track mentions, citations, competitors, recommendations, and answer accuracy against a fixed set of buyer questions. Supported engines include ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and Claude, with coverage depending on your plan.

sections.title: Diagnose the answer gap
sections.text: Review the answers and citations behind a result. Use Deep Analysis to investigate a prompt, then audit the page that could address the gap.

sections.title: Draft changes your team can review
sections.text: Use Corporate Context, your approved facts and claims, to ground briefs and drafts. Your team reviews and publishes the changes.

sections.title: Verify what moved
sections.text: Rerun the same questions after you ship. Compare recommendation, citation, and answer accuracy against your baseline, and use those results to decide which changes to make next.
